product_one_liner.value: Funnel is a marketing intelligence platform that helps marketing and data teams collect, prepare and analyze marketing data for reporting, marketing mix modeling and budget optimization.

employee_band.notes: A company profile lists 387 employees; Funnel's own about page reports more than 300.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include Filips Nastins, Developer, on the connector platform and Anirudh Mehta, Engineering Manager, on data-platform architecture and semantics.

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base contains multiple articles; its Funnel AI collection alone lists eight.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Product Engineer - AI Product Experience posting accepts applications.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model or provider was explicitly identified after reviewing product documentation, the AI FAQ, blog, security/privacy pages and subprocessor disclosures. Cloud-hosting and external MCP-client references do not establish the underlying model.

compliance_certs.notes: Funnel claims SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, ISO 27001 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: An $80 million debt facility announced January 28, 2026, from HSBC Innovation Banking and Hercules Capital; not an equity round.

raised_18mo.notes: The January 28, 2026, $80 million debt financing falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The verified openings list contained Product Engineer - AI Product Experience and Measurement Consultant, with no SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Funnel launched Digital Measurement on May 26, 2026, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated qualifying C-level or VP hire or departure was verified for the requested window. The available directory was too large for a complete tenure check; internal promotions were not counted as joins.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An employee interview identifies HubSpot as Funnel's CRM and names Gong among tools used by its commercial teams.
